title: Receive the belonging you did not manufacture
summary: Belonging is received from the One who already holds everyone. Receive belonging from the One, not from self-defense.
takeaway: Receive belonging from the One, not from self-defense.
lifeApplication: Before defending your place, remember that everyone begs from the One who already holds you.
